translation: “Who is willing to rest before death?” This is the oracle verse of the Emperor Lord. In my youth I recited it, both marveling at the strangeness of the wording and wondering at the difficulty of letting go, and my heart yearned toward it, hoping perhaps to see it once. At that time, sheltered by my two parents, I had not yet entered the world's entanglements; in the blink of an eye seventy years have passed, and the dream realm is blurred, as if serving at their knees, suddenly before my eyes.
